risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sensitive / Regulated Data Release Sanitization, sensitive and/or regulated data may be retained beyond authorized periods or recovered from improperly disposed media and equipment. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: De-Identification (Anonymization)
compensating_control_1.justification: De-Identification (Anonymization) (DCH-36) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Release (DCH-08.4) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of data protection controls.
